Compare tick-indexed arcade sound state and VIC registers on a live replay.

Host PC observations only: no guest code, registers, clocks or sound are patched.
CPU timestamps can differ; this checks the values produced at each logical tick.

limitations: One saved workload, not a worst-case timing bound
Partial poses remain and vary in both directions
Maximum native refresh and audio-service gaps increase
Shared-colour, reward, clipped and insufficient-ink cases remain excluded
No PCM/listening or physical-hardware test for this allocator-only change
